page.overview:
Who is Ashura Doji?

Ashura Doji was a bandit, samurai from Wano Country and a retainer of the Kouzuki Family, serving as one of Kouzuki Oden's Nine Red Scabbards. After Oden's death, he returned to being a criminal under the name Shutenmaru, assuming leadership of the Mt. Atama Thieves. He initially severed his ties with the Kouzuki Family in the present but rejoined after witnessing Yasuie's death.

Ashura eventually met his demise during the Raid on Onigashima, sacrificing himself to protect his fellow Scabbards from one of Kanjuro's schemes.

He is an ally of the Straw Hat Pirates during the Wano Country Arc.

Ashura Doji was a very large man with light pink puffy hair that was gathered into a topknot. He wore an open kimono with flowers on it that left his chest exposed. He had floral tattoos on his arms and upper chest.
